scope_note: Parameterized design preparation only. The illustrative N12/424 plan is not frozen or selected for execution. User scope clarification is pending.

supersedes.reason: User selected a changed weight policy and stage2 feedback. All new-policy trajectories must be fresh; the earlier 404-future draft cannot credit old20. Scope counts also remain pending.

design.selection_rule: Earliest representative of each original precision x replacement-target cell; among subsets minimize precision count imbalance, maximize distinct target funds, then choose the lexicographically earliest scenario-ID tuple. No outcome values are inputs.

design_derivation.model_call_note: Logical stages are planned workflow slots, not guaranteed API request counts.

historical_005.caution: No old response is relabeled as a fresh normalized-feedback trajectory. An offline retrospective normalization, if separately produced, is a diagnostic only.

weight_policy_boundary.implementation_owner: Separate new runner/policy module; not this schedule builder.

units.scenario: One generated market/signal case; B-main independent unit.
units.trajectory: One scenario x one fund x one arm x one replicate, containing the three-stage workflow.
units.logical_stage: One planned step in a trajectory. It is not an independent sample.
units.generation_request: An actual API attempt. A logical stage can have zero requests after early failure, or multiple tool/retry requests.
units.formula_B_main: N_scenarios x 4_funds x 5_arms x replicates = trajectories; x3 = planned logical stages.

selection_cautions: N12 retains all 3 precision x 4 original CF-target cells. Smaller supported options retain fewer cells, explicitly disclosed.
NC first4 map to source F01/F02/F03/F04, with r=.5/1/2/.5; this is source-profile coverage, not a precision-balanced NC sample.
A/C retain all four funds and five arms at replicate1 if enabled. Removing them is only a hypothetical comparison, not the selected plan.
The old confirmatory evaluator, guardian counts and finalizer are inapplicable to reduced samples.
Do not regenerate replacement assignments on a reduced scenario list. The full original60 RNG sequence is used before selecting cases.

cost_basis.method: Same documented engineering forecast as the timing review: B-family P90 x1.2, A/C extra x1.5, then preparation/analysis allowances.
limitations: Conditional planning range, not a completion promise or statistical interval.
Only one development scenario measured; new normalized-feedback policy may change outputs, tool rounds, latency and failures.
A/C exact rendered histories and capacity are unmeasured.
Thermal/power/cold load/retry events and additional offline work may extend elapsed time.

implementation.build_phase_interface: build_phase(root, config, phase, tokenizer), requires config.design_manifest_path pointing to a JSON with design specification. Draft preparation does not authorize execution.
implementation.select_phase_interface: select_phase_schedule(phase, smoke_fund_id, *, design=None) retains the legacy two-argument signature; omitted design means the illustrative N12 draft, not a launch decision.
